name: Hicon Network Technology (Shandong) Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hicon Network Technology (Shandong) Co.,Ltd. provides IPTV integrated broadcast control service in China. The company offers live broadcast; time-shifted viewing; replay/rewatching access to past broadcasts; on-demand content, including movies, tv series, variety shows, and music; specialty channels; and content recommendations services. It also provides copyright operation and marketing; and customer acquisition and technical services, as well as involved in micro-drama business. The company was formerly known as Shandong Radio and Television New Media Co., Ltd. Hicon Network Technology (Shandong) Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2010 and is based in Jinan, China.
